ENI mascot · v2

Cosmic Tendril Eye Sigil, reworked. Tapered tendrils that bend at two joints, a real eye (iris, slit, lids, glints) that follows your pointer and dilates as you get close, rings that turn, and a new effect set for every state. Same API as v1.

Live

Move the pointer around (or drag a finger). The slit widens as you approach, tendril tips brighten, and the whole body leans toward you. Click it to pet it.

At 32px and below, Mascot.svg() leaves out the fine detail (ticks, motes, sheen, photophores, iris fibres) instead of hiding it with CSS.

States

Accent colour

Mascot.mount(host, { color }) tints the tendrils, iris, aura and tips. h.setColor() changes it live.

Favicon

Mascot.favicon(state) redraws the tab icon with a status badge: amber when it needs you, red on error, teal while running.

Reduced motion is respected: with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the tracker never attaches and every animation is dropped to its static pose. Mascots scrolled out of view pause all their animations.
